title: The Bund Twilight · 外滩暮色
story: Blue hour reflections across the Huangpu River. Century-old neoclassical granite façades standing opposite the towering futuristic skyline of Lujiazui.

title: Wukang Road Sycamores · 武康路梧桐深处
story: Late afternoon autumn sunlight filtering through interlocking sycamore canopies, casting dappled shadows onto historic Art Deco brickwork.

title: West Bund Riverfront · 西岸晚霞与工业岸线
story: Giant orange maritime cranes preserved along the industrial promenade, silhouetted against an indigo and electric magenta sunset.

title: Gulou Drum Tower Alley · 鼓楼红墙与鸽哨
story: Pigeon whistles echoing in the crisp October morning breeze above traditional grey tile rooftops and deep vermilion imperial gates.

title: Jingshan Autumn Vista · 景山极顶金秋
story: A grand central axis view: autumn haze softening the sea of golden glazed tiles of the Forbidden City, glowing in late afternoon amber.

title: Dongsi Siheyuan Light · 东四胡同四合院日光
story: Carved stone door drums, bicycles parked beside leafy courtyard grapevines, and quiet midday sunlight pouring into narrow historic alleys.

title: Charles Bridge Morning Mist · 查理大桥晨曦
story: At 5:30 AM before the city awakes. Baroque sandstone saints rising through gentle river mist rising off the Vltava, pastel pink horizon beyond Kampa Island.

title: Old Town Red Tram · 老城广场与红色电车
story: The iconic Tatra red tram clattering around cobblestone curves beneath Gothic spires, incandescent streetlamps flickering to life.

title: Malá Strana Rooftops · 小城斜街千塔之城
story: Layers of terracotta tiles stretching down to St. Nicholas dome. Czech language notebooks in my coat pocket, autumn chestnuts rolling on sidewalks.

title: Victoria Harbour Star Ferry · 维港天星小轮
location: Tsim Sha Tsui to Central, Hong Kong
story: Green and white wooden ferry plowing through sparkling emerald seawater. Salty ocean spray, gentle thrum of the diesel engine, maritime breeze.

title: Central Ding Ding Tram · 中环双层电车与霓虹
location: Des Voeux Road Central, Hong Kong
story: Standing on the upper deck of a 1950s tram as it weaves between towering glass canyons and glowing bilingual neon signage.

title: Shek O Coastal Waves · 石澳海边礁石与浪花
story: Pacific waves crashing against weathered pink granite cliffs. The end of the island where the South China Sea opens toward the infinite horizon.
